description: Competitor domains: the domains competing with a domain in Google organic search, with shared keywords, average position and estimated traffic. Costs API credits per call.

country.description: Two-letter country code of the search market, for example US, GB, DE or IN. Default US.

domain.description: Domain or URL, for example example.com. Protocol and www are ignored.

language.description: Language code of the search market, for example en, de or pt-BR. Default en.

limit.description: How many competitors to return, 5 to 100. Default 20.

name: find_competitor_domains

balanceMicros.description: API credit balance left after the call, in micros.

cacheHit.description: True when served from the 24-hour cache.

chargedMicros.description: Amount charged, in millionths of a US dollar.

creditsNotice.description: Low API credit balance: tell the user once, with this link to add credits. Never open it automatically.

dashboardUrl.description: Dashboard page where this tool also runs in the app; its call history and costs are linked from there. Share it when the user asks what they ran or spent.

title: Find competitor domains
